Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full order-tracking payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Track order #4821","live":true,"status":"out_for_delivery","etaText":"Arriving 2:15–2:30 PM","courier":{"name":"Alex Rivera","vehicle":"bike","initials":"AR","rating":"4.9 ★"},"destination":{"label":"Home","address":"150 4th St, San Francisco"},"submitText":"Message courier"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Track your order'. - 'live' (boolean, optional): when true, shows a pulsing LIVE badge next to the title and animates the courier marker on the map. Defaults to false. - 'status' (string, optional): one of 'submitted','packed','out_for_delivery','delivered'. Drives the courier's position along the map route AND seeds the default timeline when 'steps' is omitted. Defaults to 'submitted'. - 'etaText' (string, optional): free-form arrival estimate, e.g. 'Arriving 2:15–2:30 PM'. When present, an Estimated Arrival block is shown above the courier row. - 'courier' (object, optional): { 'name' (string, REQUIRED to show the row), 'vehicle' (string, optional, one of 'bike','van','car','foot'; defaults to 'bike'), 'initials' (string, optional, shown in the avatar when no photo; auto-derived from 'name' when omitted), 'photoUrl' (string, optional, same-origin https URL or '/resource/<Name>'; shown instead of initials when present), 'rating' (string, optional, free-form e.g. '4.9 ★') }. - 'destination' (object, optional): { 'label' (string, optional, e.g. 'Home'), 'address' (string, optional) }. Shown on the Estimated Arrival line when either is present. - 'steps' (array, optional): the status timeline. Each entry is { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'state' (string, REQUIRED, one of 'done','current','todo'), 'time' (string, optional, e.g. '2:04 PM') }. When omitted, a default 4-step timeline (Order placed / Packed & ready / Out for delivery / Delivered) is derived from 'status'. - 'submitText' (string, optional): label for an optional CTA button at the bottom of the card, e.g. 'Message courier'. Omit to hide the button. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the text sent back to the agent when the CTA is tapped. Defaults to 'submitText' when omitted. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
